analysis.summary: Cocajola makes fast Roblox event guides: how to get each free item, badge and ticket, often several videos a day during an event like The Hollow. The thumbnails follow one strict template: 'HOW TO GET' in yellow at the top, the item or badge in the middle, the item name in red or green at the bottom, and a classic Roblox avatar pointing at it.
analysis.niche: Roblox event guides: free items, badges and tickets

styleTraits.title: One template for everything
styleTraits.detail: Yellow-to-orange 3D letters at the top ('HOW TO GET', 'DO THIS NOW', '10 EASIEST'), the reward in the centre, and its name in red or green 3D letters at the bottom. With dozens of uploads per event, viewers can spot a Cocajola guide instantly.

styleTraits.title: The reward is the hero
styleTraits.detail: The badge or item takes the middle of the frame, large and cut out: a spiky red event badge, a glowing eye, a pumpkin badge, a gold suit. A curved red arrow often points right at it.

styleTraits.title: A classic avatar as the guide
styleTraits.detail: A simple Roblox avatar with orange hair and a dark shirt stands on one side, pointing or looking at the reward. It is small and the same every time, like a presenter.

styleTraits.title: Event branding in the corner
styleTraits.detail: The event logo ('The Hollow' in red horror letters) sits beside the reward, so the thumbnail is tied to what is trending on Roblox that week.

standouts.why: About 80,000 views, 7.0 times the median. Eight event badges in a grid with red arrows and 'GET EVERY BADGE' at the bottom. A complete list promises to save time, which may be why this 45-minute guide beat the short single-badge videos.

About 62,000 views, 5.4 times the median. Three items (a green tornado, a fiery eye, a black creature) under the event logo, with 'DAY TWO ITEMS'. Grouping a whole day's rewards in one video probably made it the one to watch that day.

About 54,000 views, 4.7 times the median. '10 EASIEST' on top, '20,000' tickets in white, a row of badges and 'TICKET BADGES' in green. The number promises a shortcut, and 'easiest' speaks to players who want the reward with little effort.

lessons: For guides, put the reward itself in the middle of the thumbnail, big and cut out.
A strict template lets you publish fast during an event and still look like one channel.
Round-up videos ('every badge', 'all day two items') pulled more than single-item guides here.
Use one word that signals effort, like 'EASIEST' or 'FAST'; for reward hunters it is often the real promise.
Put the event's logo on the thumbnail so it matches what players are searching that week.
analysis.experiment: Next time you cover an update, publish one round-up guide with all the rewards in a grid next to your single-item guides, and compare the views after a week.

faq.q: How many subscribers does Cocajola have?
faq.a: As of 26 October 2026, Cocajola has about 368K subscribers and about 1.5K videos. The latest 30 uploads, all from The Hollow event, have a median of about 11,500 views. The biggest is 'How To Get ALL BADGES & TICKETS FAST in THE HOLLOW Roblox!', with about 80,000 views.

faq.q: What does Cocajola make videos about?
faq.a: Short Roblox guides on how to get free items, badges and event tickets, plus round-ups of a whole day's rewards. During big events such as The Hollow, the channel posts many videos a day, most between one and ten minutes long.

faq.q: What do Cocajola's thumbnails look like?
faq.a: Always the same layout: 'HOW TO GET' in yellow 3D letters at the top, the item or badge large in the centre with a red arrow, its name in red or green at the bottom, the event logo, and a simple orange-haired Roblox avatar pointing at the reward.
